answer: Randomness-Gated Entry Lottery. Each epoch, a beacon emits verifiable random values; an identity's admission slot is fixed only when its committed seed is combined with that beacon, so attackers cannot precompute which pseudonyms survive. Survivors are assigned a single vertex in a rotating quorum. Losers must re-commit and wait, paying fresh registration work each cycle. A zephyr of churn erodes bot farms faster than honest nodes, whose persistence lowers per-epoch cost. Attackers face repeated sunk registration across a karst of failed slots,
